items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And so we were -- and then this is when the trusteeship and Hal Davis came in. ... Hal C. Davis, right.

ctx.x: See, and at this time, I was an assistant to Barney Richards, and Leon Washington came in as a business agent, see, so that to be -- have some representation for the musicians who had come in before. Now, all of this is before the merger. See, this is before the merger. And so we were -- and then this is when the trusteeship and Hal Davis came in.
In fact, I came over to the union that day that you and the rest of the guys came in.
